items.en_title: Presidente Getúlio (SC) Health & medical procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 10 #PRI 53
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Presidente Getúlio (SC) is procuring healthcare goods or services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 85,757.14; proposals close Dec 10, 09:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
